The method of claim 2, wherein the at least one other object comprises at least one other user (302), the method further comprising: responsive to determining that the radar system (102) is stationary, recognizing, based on the other complex radar data (246), a gesture performed by the at least one other user (302).
4. The method of any preceding claim, wherein:
the at least one object comprises a first object and a second object; and the analyzing the complex radar data (246) comprises:
5. The method of claim 4, wherein:

6. The method of claim 4, wherein the determining the relative motion of the at least one user (302), the determining the relative motion of the first object, and the detecting the change in the radar system's frame of reference comprises:

analyzing, using a space-recurrent network (702), the complex radar data (246) over a spatial domain to generate feature data (714); and analyzing, using a time-recurrent network (704), the feature data (714) over a temporal domain to recognize the gesture.
7. The method of claim 6, further comprising:
storing the feature data (714) within a circular buffer (224); and accessing, by the time-recurrent network (704), the feature data (714) stored within the circular buffer (224).
8. The method of claim 6 or claim 7, wherein the analyzing the complex radar data (246) over the spatial domain comprises:

separately processing portions of the complex radar data (246) associated with different range bins (616-1 to 616-A) using a non-linear activation function to generate channel-Doppler data (712-1 to 712-A) for each range bin (616-1 to 616-A); and analyzing the channel-Doppler data (712-1 to 712-A) across the different range bins (616-1 to 616-A) to generate the feature data (714).

9. The method of any of claims 6 to 8, wherein the analyzing the feature data (714) over the temporal domain comprises forming a prediction regarding a likelihood of the radar system's frame of reference moving and the radar system's frame of reference being stationary.

10. The method of any preceding claim, wherein the analyzing the complex radar data (246) comprises analyzing magnitude or phase information of the complex radar data (246) using the machine-learned model.
